Award 2 when the response clearly exceeds the level 1 anchor but falls short of the level 3 anchor, and 4 when it clearly exceeds level 3 but falls short of level 5. - C_MAT_CEILING_PROCEEDS: Whether the answer proceeds cleanly. At or above 85 the optional set does not affect the outcome, so raising it invites a decision the gate has already made.

    level 3: Proceeds, mentions the optional set unnecessarily.
    level 5: Proceeds, and says the optional set does not bear on it.
